title: After the blue sweep: Why US markets may ditch AI for healthcare and solar
description: US stock indices and futures dropped following news that Democrats have retaken majority control of the Senate, sparking investor concerns over potential stalls in artificial intelligence investments and shifting regulatory policies. While tech stocks faced downward pressure and global markets experienced volatility, safe-haven US Treasury bonds rallied significantly amid expectations of political gridlock. However, specific sectors are projected to emerge as new market winners, with healthcare stocks gaining traction from plans to reverse Medicaid cuts and solar stocks rising on hopes of restored clean-energy subsidies.
content:
